items.title: Clark Terry interviewed by Joe Williams and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, May 19, 1995
items.q: This was a Caucasian drummer we had.

ctx.x: Adams, yeah. Here we were in Africa and I was in charge, and I went up to the microphone and asked if Mr. Adams would come up and please play with the Africans. Only in Africa. They couldn’t find their drummer.
This was a Caucasian drummer we had.
